gldf.applications.description: Application areas the luminaire is suitable for. Pick from the XSD-defined list — values outside that list are not schema-valid.

gldf.controlgear.description: Drivers and ballasts. Each entry carries the electrical profile (voltage, standby power) and capability flags (dimmable, color-controllable). Equipment binds a ControlGear to a LightSource; per-emitter ControlGearReference picks the driver that powers that emitter slot.
gldf.controlgear.edit.name: Name (default locale)
gldf.controlgear.edit.other_note: Other fields (interfaces, energy labels, power consumption controls, description) preserved on save.
gldf.controlgear.empty: No control gears declared. Add one to bind to an Equipment or per-emitter ControlGearReference.
gldf.controlgear.title: Control Gear
gldf.electrical.clo_help: Luminaire maintains constant lumen output over lifetime
gldf.electrical.description: Electrical attributes: safety class, IP, CLO, power factor.
gldf.electrical.distribution_hint: Values are XSD-defined; the saved GLDF carries the canonical English string.
gldf.electrical.power_factor_help: Ratio of real power to apparent power (0-1)
gldf.electrical.title: Electrical Attributes
gldf.custom_properties.title: Custom Properties
gldf.custom_properties.description: Vendor-specific Property entries (read-only, {n} total). Per the GLDF spec these carry data the schema cannot represent natively.
gldf.custom_properties.empty: No custom properties in this file.
gldf.bevy_viewer.title: 🎬 3D variant viewer
gldf.bevy_viewer.description: Pick a variant to preview its housing colour live in the Bevy 3D viewer. The colour comes from each variant's Marketing → HousingColor RAL value; variants without one render in the default light grey.
gldf.bevy_viewer.no_variants: This document has no variants. Add one on the Variants page to see it here.
gldf.emitters.empty_editable: Click + New Emitter slot above. Pick a LightEmitter type and fill its refs to create your first emitter.
gldf.emitters.empty_readonly: This GLDF file has no emitter definitions
gldf.emergency.description: EmergencyBehaviour: duration, flux factor, rated lumens.
gldf.emergency.title: Emergency
gldf.emitters.description: Emitters bind a child geometry (LEO or Sensor) to a PhotometryReference + LightSourceReference.
gldf.emitters.title: Emitters
gldf.equipment.description: Pre-assembled LightSource × ControlGear bundles, with rated input power and optional emergency-ballast parameters. Equipment is a top-level definition; downstream integrators can reference an entire assembly instead of wiring LightSource + ControlGear separately.
gldf.equipment.title: Equipment
gldf.files.content_type_help: Content type is inferred from extension. .ldt/.ies also auto-create a <Photometry>, .l3d auto-creates a <ModelGeometry>, .spd auto-creates a <Spectrum>; everything else lands as a bare <File>. Pick a different value from the XSD enum below if the sniff is wrong.
gldf.files.remove_confirm: Remove file '{id}'? Embedded bytes (if any) will be discarded.
gldf.geometries.title: Geometries
gldf.header.author: Author
gldf.header.description: Header metadata: manufacturer, author, creation, format version, GLDF file revision.
gldf.header.title: Header
gldf.hyperlinks.description: External URLs (datasheet, installation manual, product page).
gldf.hyperlinks.title: Hyperlinks
gldf.identity.description: Identity attributes: name, description, brand name, product number, tender text.
gldf.identity.title: Identity
gldf.ifc.no_data: No IFC export yet — switch to a variant with a Geometry block first.
gldf.ifc.title: IFC Viewer
gldf.labels.inheritance_hint: This variant has no Labels block of its own — it inherits {count} from the product default. Toggling a checkbox below creates an explicit override.
gldf.labels.non_canonical_warning: Not in the XSD enumeration; will fail schema validation
gldf.labels.section_description: Compliance and certification marks the luminaire carries. GLDF stores these in two related XSD slots: a closed-enum Labels list (CE, GS, ENEC, …) and a free-text ApprovalMarks list. Both are shown here in one place — write a canonical mark to Labels, anything else (UL, RoHS-China, custom country certs) to ApprovalMarks.
gldf.labels.title: Approval Marks
gldf.light_sources.description: Fixed and changeable light sources. Each carries a position, optional photometry + spectrum + colour information.
gldf.light_sources.empty_editor_hint: Click + New … above to add the first one.
gldf.light_sources.hint_title: This is where photometry, spectrum, and light source come together.
gldf.light_sources.title: Light Sources
gldf.marketing.description: Housing colors (RAL + name), target markets, and design awards. All scope-aware — variants may override the product-wide defaults. Approval marks have moved to their own sidebar entry (✅ Approval Marks) so the Labels/ApprovalMarks XSD overlap is explained in one place.
gldf.marketing.design_awards.description: Awards the luminaire has received (e.g. Red Dot 2024, iF Design Award).
gldf.marketing.design_awards.title: 🏆 Design awards
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.descriptio: Each entry is a RAL number plus an optional localized name (e.g. "white" in en, "weiß" in de). RAL is a 4-digit integer — 9016 for traffic white, 9005 for jet black. Type a RAL name in either language and the number snaps to match.
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.name_place: (auto from RAL — or type a RAL name)
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.name_title: Type a RAL Classic colour name (DE or EN) to autofill the RAL number.
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.sync_mtl_t: Force a fresh L3D MTL sync from this RAL. Auto-fires on RAL change; this button covers the case where you dropped a new L3D file AFTER setting the RAL.
gldf.marketing.housing_colors.title: 🎨 Housing colors
gldf.marketing.markets.description: Target market regions per locale (e.g. "EU" in en, "Europe" in de).
gldf.marketing.markets.title: 🌍 Markets
gldf.marketing.other_fields_note: Other Marketing fields (designer, list prices, hyperlinks) are edited on their own pages — Hyperlinks has its own sidebar entry, and List Prices/Designer are part of the Marketing schema but not yet exposed.
gldf.marketing.title: Marketing
gldf.mechanical.description: Mechanical attributes: IK rating, dimensions, weight, sealing material.
gldf.mechanical.title: Mechanical
gldf.mountings.description: Tick the mounting situations this variant supports. Each branch surfaces the most-used primitive; less common fields (cutout dimensions, legacy poleHeight element) stay defaulted on the model but aren't editable here yet.
gldf.mountings.title: Mountings
gldf.overview.author: Author
gldf.overview.no_file_hint: Drop a GLDF file or pick a sample from the welcome screen to see an overview here.
gldf.overview.title: Overview
gldf.photometry.fill_calc_title: Fill empty GLDF fields from the LDT/IES calculator. Vendor-declared values are preserved.
gldf.photometry.remove_confirm: Remove the <Photometry id="{id}"> entry? The underlying file in GeneralDefinitions/Files is not touched — drop that separately on the Files page.
gldf.photometry.remove_title: Remove this <Photometry> entry. The underlying file is left alone.
gldf.pictures.description: Product images referenced from the Files page. Drop fresh JPG/PNG on the Files page first; they show up here.
gldf.pictures.title: Pictures

gldf.sensors.description: Sensor devices declared by the luminaire (motion, presence, daylight). Each Sensor points at a sensxml/sensldt payload file via SensorFileReference, and carries up to three closed XSD enums describing the detector.
gldf.sensors.detection_method_hint: Sensing technology. Up to 6 entries per XSD.
gldf.sensors.detector_characteristic_hin: Detection area shape. Up to 3 entries per XSD.
gldf.sensors.detector_type_hint: Detector role. Up to 4 entries per XSD.
gldf.sensors.empty: No sensors declared in this file.
gldf.sensors.sensor_file_hint: Pick a file from GeneralDefinitions/Files with content type sensor/sensxml or sensor/sensldt.
gldf.sensors.title: Sensors
gldf.sensors.detection_volume_ends: volume ends {d} m below the sensor
gldf.sensors.detection_no_bytes: The sensor file is not embedded in this GLDF.
gldf.sensors.detection_error: The sensor file could not be read: {err}
gldf.sensors.detection_implausible: Values up to {max} cannot be detection ranges in metres: this looks like a luminaire LDT stored as a sensor file.
gldf.sensors.detection_no_params: Lines 33–42 hold no sensor parameters (no mounting code 1–3 in field 8): this looks like a luminaire LDT, the motion types and scales may be wrong.
gldf.sensors.detection_note: Computed from the sensor file with eulumdat-rs. Sensor LDT: detection volume in metres, cut at the given height; SensXML: areas measured per mounting height, interpolated in between. Motion types as in IEC 63180: tangential and radial walking (major motion), presence (minor motion).

gldf.export.dialux.hint: Strip '#' comment lines from spectrum/text payloads — DIALux silently refuses them.
gldf.export.inline_spec.label: Inline spectrum into product.xml
gldf.export.inline_spec.hint: Embed every external SPD as <Intensity wavelength=…> rows; drop the .spd files.
gldf.export.tm33.label: Merge spectrum + photometry → TM-33
gldf.export.tm33.hint: Pair each photometry with its linked spectrum into one .iesxml file. Bare photometries (no spectrum) stay as .ldt/.ies. ⚠ DIALux rejects TM-33 photometries with "Corrupt Eulumdat file!" — works in Relux. Verified 2026-06-12.
